feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: Democrats formally nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker of the House
entry.summary: The New York Democrat moved a step closer to becoming the first Black lawmaker in U.S. history to serve in the job, after House Democrats voted overwhelmingly to support him.

entry.title: House Democrat warns 13 Trump allies to save their records for upcoming investigations
entry.summary: Among the recipients of letters from Robert Garcia, incoming chair of the House Oversight Committee, are Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump, Jared Kushner and White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller.

entry.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
entry.summary: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has won one of the U.S.' most watched Senate races. And, Nvidia's board says it doesn't plan to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang despite pressure from his allies.

entry.title: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
entry.summary: Xi paid Trump a special honor by greeting him on the tarmac after Air Force One arrived in Shenzhen, reciprocating a gesture made by the U.S. president during Xi's visit to Washington in September.

entry.title: How the East Potomac golf course became a D.C. landmark — and what could happen to it
entry.summary: A federal judge is keeping East Potomac Park open for now, but hasn't ordered the government to keep the municipal golf course operational.

entry.title: Project Gryffindor: Meta's plan to get more school kids using Instagram
entry.summary: Meta said it launched its "school partnership program" to keep teens safe, but internal documents tell a different story.

entry.title: She retired early to care for family. New work rules for food aid disrupted that
entry.summary: The Trump administration's sweeping changes to SNAP food aid mean older adults up to age 65 must work or volunteer to get the benefit.

entry.title: Veteran reporter asks SCOTUS to hear case on protecting confidential sources
entry.summary: A longtime national security reporter is facing steep fines in a civil lawsuit for failing to disclose her source. She's asking the Supreme Court to weigh in.

entry.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat into Democrats' column
entry.summary: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has narrowly won Alaska's U.S. Senate race, toppling the Republican incumbent, according to a race call by The Associated Press.

entry.title: Nvidia board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
entry.summary: The former Nvidia CEO said he would be "honored" to return if the board allowed. But the board says it has no intention of reinstating him.
